name: x2-linear
hypothesis: Exact tier. prefill-mm-trim with its multi-row 4-bit linears through mk_x2mm_q4 (exact2.metal): each 4-input quad chain of the reference tree is one simdgroup 8x8x8 step whose other slots hold zeros in the token operand, so the step's fma chain is the quad's; dot sums, scale/bias term, per-lane sums in segment order and the pair tree over the 32 lane sums are explicit element-wise steps; tokens with a nonzero prescaled input below 2^-103 take the scalar reference tree (the only case where the step's +0 for an all -0 product quad could reach dot). exact2-bench at 1,024 tokens: 2.54 / 2.71 / 2.69 / 2.73 / 2.07 TMAC/s vs the elite kernel's 2.08 / 2.14 / 2.15 / 1.98 / 1.89 (2048x2048, 6144x2048, 7680x2048, 2048x7680, 512x2048), all bit-identical. GLU and projections run as separate linears (+ the reference binary op). Linears are ~70% of prefill at 4,096 and more at 1,024: expect +15% prefill at 4,096, +20% at 1,024, less at 64; decode unchanged.
